updates.title: Harry meets the door and wins
updates.body: Harold Wallace opens Floor One with a borrowed crowbar and a doorway the ceiling had opinions about. Ten mobs argue the point; the door settles it. The System logs his health bar at four slots and declines to intervene.

updates.title: Harry pays the blood tax, twice
updates.body: The Meat District charges him in advance and then charges him again. He spends most of Row Nine bleeding on other people's floors and climbs eight thousand places in the standings doing it.

updates.title: Harry pockets a key that is still warm
updates.body: A Platinum Adventurer Box hands him the Warden Key on the way down, and nobody on the crew mentions on camera that it has a temperature. He is at six slots by the Sealed Cache and back to nineteen by the Warden Hall.
